title: What Is the Bitcoin Halving? Why Only 21 Million Will Ever Exist (Beginner Guide)
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. How the Bitcoin halving works, in plain English. Sources: CoinGecko, Blockstream, The Block. AI-generated voice.

scenes.head: BITCOIN HAS A SCHEDULE
scenes.narration: Did you know new bitcoin is created on a fixed schedule, and that schedule gets cut in half again and again?

scenes.head: NEW COINS FOR MINERS
scenes.narration: Miners add new blocks to the chain. As a reward, they receive newly created bitcoin.

scenes.head: THE HALVING
items: Every two hundred ten thousand blocks
scenes.narration: About every four years, after two hundred ten thousand blocks, that reward is cut in half. This is called the halving.

scenes.head: THE LATEST NUMBERS
scenes.narration: It started at fifty bitcoin per block. After the April twenty twenty four halving, it is three point one two five.

scenes.head: A HARD CAP
scenes.narration: Because rewards keep shrinking, the total supply is capped at twenty one million coins. The last ones are expected around the year twenty one forty.

scenes.head: NOT A PRICE PROMISE
scenes.narration: A halving slows new supply, but it does not guarantee anything about price. Nobody can predict that.
